title: Only when the answer is True
heading: Only when the answer is True
description: Now use the comparison to choose whether a message appears.

scene.label: Python output for the number guessing game.

feedback.initial: Predict what will happen, then press Run.
feedback.success: Change one value and run again. Can you explain the result?
feedback.empty: Nothing was printed. Was the condition False? Try another guess.

explanation.title: Give the answer a consequence
explanation.text: if checks the question after it. When the answer is True, Python runs the indented line. When it is False, Python skips that line.

explanation.title: Which lines belong to the decision?
explanation.text: End the if line with a colon. Indent its message by four spaces. The unindented “Attempt checked.” line in the first example runs either way.
